author: thehaileybirdie
body:
IDK if these are hidden gems but here is where I like to eat.

In Brea theres The Hat for some of the best pastrami sandwiches, The Classic Cafe in Fullerton for some cozy vibes and homemeade Korean food (I love their ramen with cheese), I love The Den in Santa Ana for healthy food and artistic decor, in Orange Heemo Sushi is SO good or Sake 2 Me in Tustin (?), The Post is a good hangout spot in Villa Park its the bar attached to Rockwells, Story in Anaheim hills has the best short rib grilled cheese, and I love Bear Flag in Newport for poke.

author: bullfeathers23
body: Heemo sushi in orange is where I would go if the missiles are flying and I needed a last meal. Not to mention tacos but TACO? I hope no one who makes good tacos voted for… the other taco…
